coverage_scope: Curated partial index of the load-bearing backbone: the frontier reduction, the master theorem schema, the finite certificates, the arbitrary-order structural theorems, and every on-disk H31/H22 generic component theorem doc with its primary verifier and independent audit. This is NOT a complete mapping of every certificate document in the repository (~736 .md docs); component-boundary and divisor-level certificates are represented by their atlas entries, not individually. Entries added only when the backing document and prover exist on disk.

audit_provenance_semantics.independent_modular_audit: a distinct audit script exists and is mapped
audit_provenance_semantics.none_exists: no independent audit exists for this claim (an explicit absence, not an unmapped gap)
audit_provenance_semantics.not_yet_mapped: an audit may exist but has not been entered into this ledger
audit_provenance_semantics.historical_certificate_chain: the audit is the SAT/DRAT replay chain, not one script

conventions.verified: exact symbolic proof over C with replayable verifier
conventions.verified_generic: proved over the component function field at the generic point; divisor/boundary exclusions listed in assumptions
conventions.policy: modular evidence, numerical experiments, timeouts, and failed solver runs are never proofs; they are corroboration or diagnostics only
conventions.document_sha256_16: first 16 hex chars of the document SHA-256; check_hygiene.py recomputes and compares every non-null value

component_census.exhaustiveness_claim: all-pair-rank exceptional-graph reduction; requires quantifier review (bottleneck B3)
